deliverables.name: customer_form_structure

content.title: Return Reason Form
content.description: Please select the reason for your return. We're here to help!

reason_codes.label: We got it wrong - our sizing wasn't quite right.

sub_reasons.label: The item was too small for me.
The item was too large for me.

reason_codes.label: Our fabric didn't quite meet your expectations.

sub_reasons.label: The item pilled or frayed quickly.
The item shrunk after washing.
The item had an unpleasant smell.

reason_codes.label: Our colour didn't match your expectations.

sub_reasons.label: The item wasn't the colour I expected.
The item faded quickly.
The item had uneven dyeing or patchiness.

reason_codes.label: Our style or fit didn't quite work for you.

sub_reasons.label: The item had an unflattering cut or design.
The item was poorly constructed or made.
The item didn't match the product description.

reason_codes.label: Our material wasn't what you expected.

sub_reasons.label: I was expecting a natural fibre, but it's synthetic.
I was expecting a synthetic fibre, but it's natural.
The type of material used wasn't what I expected.

reason_codes.label: There was an issue with the product itself.

sub_reasons.label: The item tore or ripped easily.
The item was missing parts or components.
The zippers or fasteners were broken or faulty.

reason_codes.label: There was an issue with the delivery.

sub_reasons.label: My item arrived late, beyond the expected timeframe.
I didn't receive my item at all.
The wrong item was delivered to me.

deliverables.instructions: Copy this structure into Typeform, Google Forms, or your returns portal.

deliverables.name: weekly_summary_template
deliverables.content:
# Weekly Returns Summary — Birdsong London

Subject: Your weekly returns snapshot

Hi team,

Here is this week's returns-reason breakdown:

- Top return reason: {{top_reason}} ({{top_reason_pct}}% of returns)
- Total returns this week: {{total_returns}}
- Week-over-week change: {{wow_change}}

Recommended action: review whether {{top_reason}} points to a sizing, description, or quality fix on the affected product(s).

— Generated by AIYYARY
deliverables.instructions: Use this template for a weekly email reviewing returns data.
